purpose: Select the next small, low-risk claim-cleanup batch without manually choosing convenient entries or weakening the canonical editorial priority order.

blocked_rules.action: Keep withheld and route through actual-source and safety review.
Review the source against the exact public claim before rewriting or retaining it.
Leave in the broader editorial queue; do not consume the phase-one enforced-claim batch.

guardrails: Do not auto-promote any record to reviewed.
Do not attach a vaguely related source merely to preserve inherited wording.
Do not skip blocked higher-priority entries silently; expose them in the batch report.
A practical rewrite must remove enforced evidence claims and preserve a bounded observable action.
If a safe practical rewrite is not possible, keep or move the record to a withheld state.
